_comment: The one place to change project status. status: Live | Next | Planned. Rendered by assets/site.js on Home and Projects. Stage 2-5 wording follows the approved plan in CLAUDE.md.
engagement: One independent, simulated engagement for a fictional hotel group with two properties and synthetic data.

stages.name: Hotel Operations Knowledge Assistant
stages.summary: Cited, property-specific policy answers for front-desk staff.
stages.delivers: Front-desk staff ask policy questions and get cited, property-specific answers, or an honest "check with a manager".

stages.name: Guest Request Agent
stages.summary: Drafts cited replies to guest emails; staff approve every send.
stages.delivers: An agent that reads guest emails, checks bookings and policy (using stage 1 as a tool) and drafts a reply that staff approve before anything is sent.

stages.name: Eval Harness
stages.summary: One eval harness for both assistants: 181 cases, gates in CI, a judge checked against hand labels.
stages.delivers: One evaluation system for stages 1 and 2: 181 labelled cases, the projects' own metrics, regression gates in both repos' CI, and an LLM judge that counts only once it agrees with hand labels.

stages.name: Production Deployment
stages.summary: Eval-found gaps fixed, redacted persistent logs, budgets in CI, monitoring.
stages.delivers: Both live apps hardened: four gaps the evals found fixed and measured, personal data redacted before storage, a staff role, latency and cost budgets gated in CI, a kill switch and an Operations page.

stages.name: Client Handoff
stages.summary: Runbooks, SLOs and guides the team can own.
stages.delivers: A handoff package for the hotel group's IT and operations teams: architecture, decision index, eight runbooks, SLOs and budgets, staff and admin guides, a readiness checklist, a 30/60/90-day plan and a daily health check.
